title: Why Does a Fan Make You Feel Cooler?
short_title: Why a fan makes you feel cooler
description: A fan does not cool the air, so why does it feel cooler? The simple science of sweat and evaporation.
tags: why does fan make you feel cool
comment: Is your fan on right now? Tell me below!

scenes.text: A fan does not cool the air. So why do you feel cooler?
Your skin has tiny amounts of sweat. When sweat dries, it takes heat away from your body.
Around your skin, a thin layer of warm, damp air builds up. That slows the drying.
The fan blows that layer away and brings drier air, so sweat dries faster, and you feel cooler.
The fan motor even adds a little heat to the room.
So switch the fan off when you leave the room, because it cools you, not the room.
